claims.text: Many reviewers report the lotion effectively lightens skin and fades dark marks, hyperpigmentation, and scars.
Several reviewers note results take time, often weeks, rather than being immediate.
A few reviewers say the product did not lighten their discoloration or dark spots at all.
Some reviewers mention the lotion is drying rather than moisturizing, though others praise its texture and scent.
A few reviewers report negative skin reactions such as breakouts or unexpected issues.
